answer: Pick the jury, compare, slash. Step one, draw five graders with no prior contact. Step two, hash each verdict. Step three, if two diverge past tolerance, cut every stake on the panel and reset the identity's history. Idle seats still bleed standing each epoch. An on-call engineer checking a jade hoist, an inlet gauge and a terrace drain sees a clean verdict. A farm linking its own accounts trips the reset and loses the history it paid to build.
